test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 14 March 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Anup bought some pens for ₹ 9,500. He sold 40% pens at a loss of 12% and one-third of the remaining pens at a profit of 25%. At what per cent profit should he sell the remaining pens, so as to earn a profit of 10% in the entire transaction?
solution:
**Calculations:**

Let the total pen be 100 and cost of each pen be "x".

According to the question-

⇒ 40 × 0.88x + 20 × 1.25x + 40 × a = 100 × 1.1x

⇒ 40a = 110x - 60.2x

⇒ a = 49.8xover 40 = 1.245x

Profit = 1.245x - x = 0.245x

Profit % = 0.245xover x × 100 = 24.5 % profit
